list: Official PlayStation list, cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Finish the other 54 trophies first; this platinum is the final reward for completing the full list. Keep a tracker beside your in-game progress and revisit cleanup tasks after the story, since nearly everything except one meditation is available in free roam.
steps: Complete the other 54 trophies.
Check the list for any remaining cleanup before the platinum unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening story mission, Gone Fishing, and complete its objectives to earn this automatic story trophy. Keep moving through the chapter rather than hunting for a separate activity; the mission completion is the trigger.
steps: Start the opening story mission Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission objectives.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 1 story missions and let the chapter close normally. Before advancing beyond this opening chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth and keep a Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude is secured.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 story missions.
Do the balcony meditation before leaving the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Advance through the Chapter 2 main missions until the chapter is complete; this is a story-progress award rather than a challenge with a separate counter. Use this chapter to unlock activities and keep scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel.
steps: Follow the Chapter 2 main story.
Complete the chapter finale and check the trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 storyline to earn this automatic trophy. Yago's Race Against Yago strand is time-sensitive while its hourglass is shown, so make a manual save and take that race when it appears before focusing on later chapters.
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 story missions.
When the hourglass appears for Yago's races, save and do the strand.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story missions. The optional That's Where The Money Is mission near the chapter's end opens bank-vault jobs, so start that chain when available if you want to begin the vault trophies before free-roam cleanup.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 story missions.
Start That's Where The Money Is when the optional mission appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final main-story mission for this gold trophy. Keep a manual save before launching it, both for a safe return point and because the guide's only missable meditation should already be done before the story moves past Chapter 1.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final story mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it becomes part of the story progression. It awards automatically on completion, so follow the mission objectives and check the tracker afterward rather than repeating unrelated activities.
steps: Start Breakfast Run when it is available.
Finish its mission objectives.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play and complete The Cartel Heist as it appears in the story. The trophy follows mission completion; keep the chapter save habit for the separate meditation missable and continue optional strands when their markers appear.
steps: Launch The Cartel Heist from its story marker.
Complete the mission and verify the unlock.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play when the story makes the mission available. This is a straightforward mission trophy, so the useful preparation is to keep a Chapter 1 save for the separate meditation trophy and avoid cheats on the trophy save.
steps: Start Child's Play from the story prompt.
Finish the mission without relying on cheats.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission in the main story. The trophy is tied to its finish, so continue the chapter naturally and use the remaining time for side jobs only when they do not delay the time-sensitive Yago strand.
steps: Follow the story until Headliners is offered.
Complete the mission to register the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story and complete its objectives. This is a story completion unlock; retain a manual save before major chapter changes if you are also protecting progress on the Chapter 1 meditation.
steps: Start VCIA Takedown from its story marker.
Complete the mission and confirm the trophy appears.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory as part of the main story. It unlocks from mission progression and does not require a medal or alternate ending; keep your attention on any optional time-sensitive strand before moving on.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete its objectives to earn the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, use Progress > Stats > 100% Completion as the master checklist; earlier work counts. Prioritize robberies and fencing to fund gear, then work through collectibles and activities, including 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70 challenges and 15 target decks.
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story.
Use the checklist to finish robbery, collectible and activity categories.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build the counter across stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps as you explore. The trophy asks for 250; 100% completion asks for 300, so keep going beyond the unlock if the roadmap is your goal.
steps: Mix the four stunt types while exploring Leonida.
Reach 250 for the trophy, or 300 for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the nine activity types at least once instead of repeating a favorite. Use the activity list to spot a category you have not tried, then complete one attempt in it and check the trophy counter before moving on.
steps: Try one activity from each of the nine types.
Review the counter for any category still missing.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit both shooting ranges and earn gold in all 42 challenges between them. Keep a note of the challenges that fall short so you can return for only the missing gold medals during the 100% cleanup.
steps: Complete the challenges at both shooting ranges.
Replay any challenge without gold until all 42 are gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations and win at least one race at each. For 100% completion the longer checklist tracks 42 drone time trials, so use the trophy unlock as a checkpoint rather than assuming the broader requirement is done.
steps: Locate the Top Fun drone race markers.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Enter distinct race events and finish first in 20 different races; replaying a single event does not build a list of different wins. The 100% checklist separately tracks 30 of 40 unique races, so keep racing after the trophy if completion is the objective.
steps: Choose different race events rather than repeating one course.
Win 20 distinct races and check the counter.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and enter his fishing challenge, then finish ahead of him. The trophy is earned by winning that contest rather than merely fishing elsewhere, so follow the challenge prompt and confirm the result screen records your win.
steps: Find Cal and start a fishing challenge.
Beat his score in the contest.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade cabinet through to completion; starting a game or leaving it mid-run is not enough. The wider 100% activity list asks you to play all four video games, so sample the remaining cabinets while you are cleaning up activities.
steps: Choose an arcade game and play it to its finish condition.
For 100%, play each of the four video games.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's optional stranger strand through its final mission; the strand remains available after the main story. Keep it on the cleanup list and finish the finale, rather than stopping after an early encounter.
steps: Follow Andy's stranger strand through its missions.
Complete its final mission after the story if needed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's optional missions until his final strand mission is complete. This side-story finale stays open after the main story, making it a cleanup task if you did not finish it during the campaign.
steps: Continue Kenton's optional strand as its missions appear.
Finish the finale to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's optional stranger strand through its final mission. It remains open after the story, so return to its markers in cleanup and make sure the finale—not only the first meeting—has registered.
steps: Pick up and progress Billy's stranger missions.
Complete Billy's final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands and check the trophy's progress counter after each finale. Andy, Billy and Tyrone have separate trophies and do not count toward this requirement; Yago's Chapter 3 race strand is time-sensitive, so save and do it when its hourglass appears.
steps: Complete qualifying stranger strand finales and check the counter.
Do not count Andy, Billy or Tyrone; handle Yago's timed strand in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Progress Randy's optional stranger storyline to its final mission and complete that finale. It remains available after the main campaign, so this can be handled during the final sweep alongside the other side-story endings.
steps: Follow Randy's stranger missions as they become available.
Finish the final mission in the strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's optional strand all the way through its last mission. This finale stays available after the story; return to Tyrone's markers in cleanup if the trophy has not appeared yet.
steps: Progress Tyrone's optional missions.
Finish the final mission for the strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots, and Lucia's balcony session can disappear after Chapter 1. After Down to Earth, visit Jason's house in the morning, follow Lucia onto the balcony and accept the meditation; do it anyway, keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops, and use both characters at outdoor spots that can count twice. The balcony requirement is not fully confirmed, so treat that exact trigger as still being confirmed.
steps: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, visit Jason's house in the morning and accept Lucia's balcony meditation.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy unlocks; meditate at all 18 spots, using both characters outdoors.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret Vogel's hunting questline as Jason and hunt the unique animal he assigns. A clean head or heart shot preserves the carcass, which helps with the related hunting objective and Bret's target-deck progression toward 100%.
steps: Start Bret Vogel's Jason-only hunting questline.
Take a clean head or heart shot at the assigned animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets by gathering each set's required cards, then verify the set completion in the collectibles tracker. This silver trophy's three sets are separate from Bret's target decks, which have their own 15/15 100% checklist entry.
steps: Collect the cards needed for a complete set.
Finish three sets and confirm them in the tracker.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to tag locations as you travel around Leonida and keep going until its count reaches 100. The 100% checklist tracks WAiNK locations too, so check the in-game counter rather than assuming a nearby scan counted.
steps: Open the WAiNK app as you explore.
Tag and verify 100 distinct locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Challenges and complete any 50 listed challenges; the separate 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80. Use the menu to choose approachable unfinished tasks and return to it periodically to confirm the count.
steps: Review the challenge list under Progress > Challenges.
Complete 50 challenges for the trophy, then continue toward 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a four-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then lose the police and leave the red heat zone. The trophy can wait until you are fully clear of the zone, so do not stop as soon as the flashing search area begins to fade.
steps: Raise the Wanted Level to four stars with your partner.
Escape and leave the red heat zone completely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and rob three shops in succession while police still actively pursue you. If the stars disappear and only the red heat area remains, the chain breaks; after the third shop, stay alive and clear the pursuit while the delayed unlock registers.
steps: Unlock character switching after Coffee Break and call your partner.
Rob three shops during one uninterrupted active pursuit, then escape.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app while driving through traffic; each newly discovered vehicle model advances the counter. The trophy needs 100 discoveries, while the 100% checklist asks for 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning after the unlock if needed.
steps: Scan unfamiliar traffic vehicles with WAiNK.
Track the counter to 100 for the trophy and 200 for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming, activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3 together, then down five enemies before that single use ends. A group at an illegal operation gives you several targets close together, and an assault rifle plus adrenaline can extend the window.
steps: Aim at a group and activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3.
Down five enemies before the same Focus use expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, take a large passenger plane from a boarding bridge such as gates E3 or E4; aircraft parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Turn toward the runway and take off, then fly roughly one kilometre away for the delayed unlock, and save first because police arrive quickly.
steps: Save, then steal a passenger plane from a boarding bridge at VCIA.
Take off and fly about one kilometre away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks can be found on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Make a manual save before approaching, get into a tank and drive and fire until the trophy unlocks; the exact trigger still being confirmed means do not assume an unverified combat condition.
steps: Save before visiting the south side of Mile Zero Air Station.
Get into a Rhino tank, drive and fire while checking for the unlock.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun, then use it on a jewelry store's locked back door instead of kicking it open. Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen; if anyone spots you, reload and try again.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Open the back door quietly, use the code note on the safe and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank-vault jobs open after the optional That's Where The Money Is mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van and enter the vault while its guard is there; bring your partner because one character cannot carry every bag, then escape the instant four stars appear.
steps: Unlock the vault jobs through That's Where The Money Is.
Rob five vaults with your partner and escape each one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept and rob an armored truck, then keep going until you have escaped the police heat completely. The unlock can wait until you leave the red heat zone, so do not treat the fading search area as the finish point.
steps: Stop and rob an armored truck.
Lose the pursuit and leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Travel across the state and uncover its regions instead of staying around Vice City. Check the map for areas that remain undiscovered, then visit those spaces directly; exploration progress can accumulate naturally while you work on collectibles and activities.
steps: Explore new regions across Leonida as you travel.
Review the map and visit any areas still undiscovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of Leonida's nine gangs for the trophy; the 100% checklist asks for all 39 operations. Keep a gang-by-gang note so you do not repeat a completed crew while leaving another untouched.
steps: Locate the illegal-operation sites and identify the gang at each.
Rob one operation for each of the nine gangs, then continue toward 39 for 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and try having a cocktail somewhere with a clear view over the water. The precise interaction that triggers this trophy is not confirmed by the available sources, so the exact trigger still being confirmed; avoid treating one particular spot or time as verified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Look for a vehicle showroom and attempt the published smash-and-escape idea, but note that the exact method is still unconfirmed. The sources do not establish a reliable showroom, vehicle or escape sequence, so avoid presenting a guessed route as fact.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kingpin Bowling illegal operation, take all three valuables: the office luxury watch, the table shotgun and the office safe contents. Use a Sticky Bomb on the safe and escape the police; if you leave anything behind, the operation returns later, so this is not a one-shot missable.
steps: Visit Kingpin Bowling and collect the watch, shotgun and safe contents.
Use a Sticky Bomb on the safe and escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to its maximum, then confirm their shared progress in the stats menu. A gym membership lets you train, and your partner can work out alongside you, making the paired stat grind easier to manage.
steps: Get a gym membership and train Strength with each character.
Continue until both characters reach maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Robberies, fights and other actions that alter your Criminal Profile contribute to this cumulative counter. Let it build during normal play, then check the profile progress rather than grinding a single action that may not add credit.
steps: Play normally while doing actions that change the Criminal Profile.
Check the counter as it approaches 500 recorded actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The phrase hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but the unlock method is not confirmed in the available references. Treat the exact trigger as still being confirmed and avoid relying on an unverified activity or location until a source establishes it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description does not identify the event behind this trophy, and the exact trigger still being confirmed. Keep it on the cleanup list and wait for a verified method rather than treating a speculative encounter as a reliable requirement.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking someone down with a melee hit from a moving vehicle, but the precise method remains unconfirmed. The exact trigger still being confirmed; keep experimenting only when safe and do not treat any particular vehicle or weapon setup as verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder the money. The $250,000 goal is cumulative, so keep using the contacts as more bills arrive rather than trying to finish it in one transaction.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from bank and payday-loan jobs.
Sell bills to contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend money across the available shop types and let the total accumulate toward $100,000. Purchases are cumulative across stores, so use normal gear and supply upgrades while playing instead of buying everything in one visit.
steps: Buy useful items across different shop types.
Continue spending until the cumulative total reaches $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2 unlocks the Vice City Real Estate app, buy all eight garages; the story's free garages do not count. The full set costs about $160,000, so use robbery and fence income to fund the purchases.
steps: Complete Daily Driver to unlock the Real Estate app.
Buy all eight garage properties, budgeting about $160,000.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses opens the Scooter Bros app during the Chapter 2 mission, then take a stolen car to him and choose Respray followed by Register. From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray can register vehicles with a standard tracker; each one needs a free garage space, so buy garages and use inexpensive cars.
steps: Complete Moses to unlock Scooter Bros; use Respray then Register.
Register 10 different vehicles, keeping enough free garage spaces.
